theorem.name: FIXED_SUPPORT_SIGNED_TRANSPORT_DISCOVERY
theorem.statement: For every fixed constant K, exhaustive deterministic enumeration of signed permutations with non-identity support at most K has O(n^K) candidates up to a K-dependent constant. Each R44BP transport candidate is polynomially checkable. Therefore the covered fixed-support transport class is polynomial-time discoverable.

infinite_family.transport_behavior: same local signed permutation in distinguished copy; identity elsewhere
infinite_family.consequence: arbitrarily large exact states admit deterministic polynomial discovery plus safe destructive rank descent
